stories.title: 25 Fields Medalists: AI labs’ math race is severely misaligned

facts.text: Primary declaration at mathandai.org — “A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics” — signed by 25 Fields Medalists including Terence Tao, Peter Scholze, Maryna Viazovska, and 2026 medalist Yu Deng.
Core claim: racing LLMs to solve landmark problems as marketing benchmarks skips writeups, attribution, and the human teaching/digest cycle that turns solutions into understanding.
Signatories warn mass true/false dumps can erode fertile ground for ideas; urge labs and society to keep the purpose of the work in view — not just the scoreboard.
HN front page tonight (~236 points / 331 comments) plus endorsements page already past ~690 names; Le Monde / New Scientist amplify Tao’s critique of rushed AI math drops.

stories.whyItMatters: A rare Fields-heavy open letter aimed at the benchmark-industrial complex — timed while AI labs sell math breakthroughs as trophies.

stories.title: Tencent-backed Enflame closes +179% on Shanghai STAR debut

facts.text: Reuters: Shanghai Enflame Technology (688801.SS) closed at 397 yuan Friday, +179% vs 142.18 offer; opened 410, high 475; IPO raised 6.12 bn yuan (~$912M).
Market value ~171 bn yuan at the close (~2.8× IPO valuation); one of China’s “four little GPU dragons”; Tencent largest shareholder (~17.95%) and ~84% of 2025 revenue.
Still unprofitable (2025 net loss narrowed to 1.16 bn yuan); plans proceeds for 5th/6th-gen AI chips; Golem also flagged the 179% jump in the German tech feed.

stories.whyItMatters: Another domestic-AI-chip listing that nearly triples on day one while Beijing pushes Nvidia alternatives — scarcity premium, thin float, and policy all in one tape.

stories.title: Prien: kids’ digital-protection report → Kabinett; age rules still vague

facts.text: heise / ZEIT: Bildungs- und Familienministerin Karin Prien took the Expertenkommission’s Abschlussbericht (56 recommendations) Friday and will bring it to Kabinett next week.
Eckpunkte for SGB VIII / Jugendschutzgesetz changes targeted mid-October; a Sofortprogramm (incl. “KI-Seepferdchen” for Grundschule) should start still in 2026.

Prien keeps pushing a Social-Media Altersgrenze (~13) plus platform safety-by-design; the commission itself stayed split between a hard age floor and offer-by-offer limits — EU speech from von der Leyen due Wednesday.

stories.whyItMatters: Germany is finally putting a clock on kids’ social-media rules — but the hard numbers still wait on Brussels and October Eckpunkte.

stories.title: Claude 18+ age assurance hits HN after Yoti verification wave

facts.text: Anthropic Help Center (consumer Claude): product is 18+ only; accounts flagged for possible minor use must verify age via Yoti (selfie estimate, ID photo, or Yoti Digital ID) before reinstatement.
Anthropic says it only gets pass/fail from Yoti — not the selfie/ID images — and will disable accounts on indicators of under-18 activity.

HN tonight: “Claude is only available to people over 18 years” ~470 points / 520 comments pointing at the help article — a fresh enforcement/visibility spike, not a brand-new policy page (dated May 18).

stories.whyItMatters: Age-gating plus third-party biometrics is becoming table stakes for consumer AI — and tonight’s HN pile-on shows how sharp the lockouts feel when the filter trips.
